text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Fan Fest—an annual academy event that's held especially for fans. However…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, look! It's Tamamo Cross! Tamamo Cross!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan B
text_block_list.text: You're right! I can't believe I'm seeing the Tamamo Cross! In real life!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The Tamamo Cross?! Didja hear that?! They know who I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her popularity continuing to climb, Tamamo Cross's posse of devoted fans is growing larger too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, what a racket…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Lemme be honest, Trainer. This whole "fan" thing isn't clickin' with me…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm no celebrity. 'Sides, it's not like I'm runnin' to make the fans happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So how come they're all cheerin' me on? I don't get it one bit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross struggles to understand the fan mentality.
choice_data_list: Why don't you ask the fans themselves?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Worth a shot, I guess. Lemme try callin' one over…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, you. I was wondering… What made you a fan of me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan C
text_block_list.text: Well, you always go above and beyond for your family, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan C
text_block_list.text: You want the best for your mom, your dad, and your siblings, too. That's a lot of people to be shouldering with that small frame.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How come ya know 'bout all that?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan C
text_block_list.text: Well, your story's been in magazines and on the internet, too. After learning all about you, I really want to see you win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Fan C
text_block_list.text: I want to see you happy, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: R-really… Well, thanks a bunch. Ya sure know a lot about me…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Anyways, what I'm hearin' is that you're sympathetic. But at the end of the day, I'm still just a stranger, yeah? So why…

text_block_list.name: Distant Scream
text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what was that?! Sounds like it came from the school buildin'. Da heck's goin' on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We rush to the source of the shriek…

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oguriiii! Oguriiii!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just a buncha groupies. What did you do to set 'em all off, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nothing, I think. I was just walking by…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap! You burst outta the regionals and now you're winning graded races one after another… You're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Will you be entering the Satsuki Sho? What's next for you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They're even makin' a huge fuss over a newbie like Oguri…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Her only graded wins are two G3s… You're tellin' me she's got fans this devoted already? Make it make sense.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: EEEEEK! OGURI!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm still wrappin' my head 'round this fan stuff, but let's just get outta here for now! Trainer, Oguri, dis way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Pant… Sure is gettin' wild out there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I knew the Twinkle Series was big, but I didn't think it was this big…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I knew that more people came to see these races than the regional ones, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is definitely popular, but the passion surrounding Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap is another level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After witnessing the fans' passion first-hand, I can't help thinking…
choice_data_list: This could be the start of something.
This could be the start of something.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? The start of… what?
choice_data_list: Of… a special moment in time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Between Tamamo Cross's family and Oguri Cap's countryside background, both of them are influenced by their roots.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like that's what their fans find so deeply appealing—to the point that they're offering their unwavering support.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is goin' over my head, but if the hype doesn't die down… what are we gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: How are we gonna focus on races with fans screeching and squealing like that? It's startin' to freak me out…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Tama… Their cheers will give us courage.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fan support won't hold us back. In fact, it'll awaken our dormant strength.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That so? Well, considerin' how popular ya were in the regionals, I'll take your word for it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer. Let's head back.
choice_data_list: Back to where the fans are?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. If they're gonna make us stronger, it's only fair we give 'em some attention.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Get your game face on, Oguri. We're on different racin' tours, so I'll take my tour's fans and you take yours. There can't be that much overlap, right? Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap doesn't respond… But moments later, the two are chatting cheerily with their fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Where will this passion take us? Clouds like I've never seen start to circle around us—a growing vortex.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the two return, there's an unusual request waiting for them.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck?! You want me 'n Oguri to host a talk show?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, we've had an abundance of requests.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: Apparently, people are very interested in hearing a discussion between you both. I know this is all very sudden, but how about it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez. Guess there's no accountin' for taste, huh. Trainer, ya think chattin' like we always do in our room'll be interestin' enough for 'em?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're on board, that's good enough for me. C'mon, Oguri, we got a show to prep for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so the hastily planned talk show kicks off…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Truth is, we don't need no alarm clock in our room.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Every mornin', like clockwork, a certain someone's tummy starts growlin' at breakfast o'clock. That "Grrrr" is guaranteed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Whoa… That's one incredible alarm.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey! This is your tummy I'm talkin' about here! I know you're da clock, but don't you start actin' cuckoo!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Much to their fans' delight, they play off each other seamlessly, and it's not long before their discussion has turned into something of a comedy routine.
